## Walkthrough

A new test file validates the `RefineExternalitiesImpl.historicalLookup` method, and the implementation is refactored to accept configuration parameters. The `RefineExternalitiesImpl` class now requires `currentServiceId` and `lookupState` during instantiation through a new `RefineExternalitiesParams` type. The `historicalLookup` method now retrieves preimage data from the provided lookup state, falling back to the current service ID when none is specified. Integration changes in in-core.ts propagate these parameters through the refinement call chain.
